content.title: The Repairman’s Blacklist: 3 TV Brands to Never Buy
content.text: The Repairman’s Blacklist: 3 TV Brands to Never Buy OUR TECHNICIAN-APPROVED TV PICKS: ➤ Sony BRAVIA 8 II 65 Inch TV (Reliability Champion): https://geni.us/zkruAx ➤ Samsung QLED 4K QN90F (Best for Features): https://geni.us/xHeBT ➤ LG OLED evo AI 4K C5 Smart TV (Best Value): https://geni.us/VJUUkU1 I spent a month interviewing TV repair technicians, analyzing warranty claims, and digging through repair forums. The truth? Professionals see failure patterns consumers never do and one of the brands on their "blacklist" might be in your living room right now. In this video, we expose the 3 TV brands repairmen tell their own families to avoid at all costs, and the 3 they actually trust. We cover: ✦ The House Brand Trap: Why heavily discounted holiday TVs are designed to die the second their warranty expires. ✦ The Warranty Nightmare: The budget brand with a massive 15% failure rate and terrible customer service. ✦ The Technician’s Choice: Why spending a little more upfront on reliable panels saves you hundreds in early replacements. 👇 Tell me in the comments: What TV brand are you currently using, and how many years has it lasted? DISCLAIMER: This video is for educational and entertainment purposes only, based on service data, surveys, and personal analysis. Always perform your own due diligence before purchasing.
